name: openspecui-monorepo
description: Local multi-workspace visual workbench and read-only Git companion for OpenSpec

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@openspecui/shared && npm run build --workspace=@openspecui/web && npm run build --workspace=openspecui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@openspecui/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=openspecui && npm run typecheck --workspace=@openspecui/web
